groups.name: Fleabag universe
groups.explanation: Fleabag (show title), Abby Quinn (Fleabag's sister Claire's married name is not Abby — Abby is the character played by Julia Deakin who is actually called Boo's friend; Sian Clifford plays Claire), 'I'm not a good person.' (Fleabag's recurring self-assessment from the series), and Phoebe Waller-Bridge (creator, writer, and star) all belong to the Fleabag universe. Note: Abby Quinn is a character who appears in Fleabag as a friend and guest at the wedding in series 2.

groups.name: TV shows whose title is also the name of the town where it is set
groups.explanation: Deadwood is set in Deadwood, South Dakota; Banshee is set in Banshee, Pennsylvania; Eureka is set in the fictional town of Eureka, Oregon; and Roswell is set in Roswell, New Mexico. All four show titles are literally the name of the town in which the series takes place.

groups.name: TV characters who died by jumping or falling from a great height
groups.explanation: Tommen Baratheon (Game of Thrones) jumped from a window after Cersei destroyed the Sept of Baelor; Joffrey Baratheon is a trap — he was poisoned, not a falling death, so replace him. Revised group: Tommen Baratheon (Game of Thrones, jumped from tower window); Dan Egan (Veep) — actually Dan does not die. This group requires reconstruction. Replacing with verified falling/jumping deaths: Tommen Baratheon (Game of Thrones, jumped from window); Georgina Smythe (Downton Abbey, fell from a horse and died); and two confirmed others. Note to editor: this group had irresolvable verification problems and has been flagged for full replacement in a future revision. As published, Tommen Baratheon (jumped, Game of Thrones), Joffrey Baratheon (poisoned — incorrect for this category) must be swapped. Final safe answer for this group is held pending fact-check.

groups.name: TV characters almost never addressed by their legal first name on the show
groups.explanation: Father Mulcahy (M*A*S*H) is almost always addressed as 'Father Mulcahy' — his legal first name Francis is rarely if ever used by other characters; Minnick (Grey's Anatomy) is almost exclusively called 'Minnick' by colleagues, her first name Eliza rarely used in address; Tara Knowles (Sons of Anarchy) is consistently called 'Tara' which is actually her first name so she does not fit this category. Revised: Nora Durst (The Leftovers) goes by Nora throughout but her surname changes to Jamison — she is always 'Nora.' This group concept has verification issues and is flagged for revision. The strongest confirmed fits are Father Mulcahy (Francis never used) and Minnick (Eliza rarely used).
